### Fixed
- The shared `RemoteMCPServer agent-platform/muster` reported `Accepted=False (ReconcileFailed … Unauthorized)` on every installation: the kagent controller lists a server's tools with its own request, which carries no bearer, and muster (an OAuth resource server) answers 401 (#299). While muster runs with OAuth on (`muster.muster.oauth.server.enabled`, the default) the connectivity chart now labels the CR `kagent.dev/discovery: disabled`, the opt-out from controller-side tool discovery contributed upstream (kagent-dev/kagent#2752, `0.10.x` backport kagent-dev/kagent#2753): a controller that knows the label reports `Accepted=True` (`DiscoveryDisabled`, empty inventory); an older one ignores the label and behaves as before. Agents are unaffected — they resolve tools at run time as the caller. A controller credential through `spec.headersFrom` was rejected on purpose: the kagent runtime applies static headers after the propagated caller token, so every agent would have acted as the controller's ServiceAccount (docs/authentication.md, "Tool discovery by the kagent controller"). `make verify-kagent-discovery` asserts the label follows the OAuth toggle and stays off the operator-defined `kagent.remoteMcpServers`.
